people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
translations.bsb: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
translations.kjv: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
translations.asv: always bearing about in the body the dying of Jesus, that the life also of Jesus may be manifested in our body.
